method: One model judge (this session's Claude) reading each document and answering the five Resume craft criteria in ../../resume-craft.json, without sight of the deterministic answers. Written down rather than called live: no provider credentials in this environment, so ticket 12 used the same recorded-verdict proxy as 05 and 11. `scanned` is absent because it has no text layer at all.

evidence.C3: 'Shipped a LoRA fine-tune of Mistral-7B for ticket triage' -- triage is the problem the work served
evidence.C4: LLM serving and evals in the first role, feature pipelines and retraining in the second
evidence.C5: every bullet carries a system, a number and a change; none would survive being moved
